title: Move code-policy rule defaults to meta.defaultOptions and deprecated.replacedBy once the ESLint peer floor reaches 9.21
notes: typescript-eslint 8.73 deprecates the top-level defaultOptions and meta.replacedBy. 12 sites in packages/eslint-plugin-code-policy/src/rules carry a reasoned eslint-disable for @typescript-eslint/no-deprecated because the peer range starts at eslint 9.0 and the contract tests pin the rule shape.
done_when: No no-deprecated suppression is left in src/rules and the contract tests pass on the new shape.
